plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to eliminate risk.
Reduce broad index (SPY) to lower concentration.
Increase income ETF (QQQI) for stability and yield.
Add to quality tech (CRWD) for growth potential.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with reduced leverage.
conservative.read: This mode targets ~1.5% monthly growth with a focus on capital preservation. Expect lower drawdowns but also slower growth compared to other modes.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to reduce risk.
Reduce broad index (SPY) to address concentration.
Increase income ETF (QQQI) for stability.
Add to quality tech (CRWD) for growth.
This balanced approach seeks growth while managing risk.
balanced.read: This mode targets ~2.5% monthly growth with a risk-first approach. It blends growth and stability, aiming for moderate drawdowns.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) for amplified gains.
Reduce broad index (SPY) to concentrate capital.
Add to high-conviction tech (CRWD) for growth.
Buy inverse semiconductor ETF (SOXS) to hedge or profit from downturns.
This aggressive plan aims for high growth but carries significant risk.
aggressive.read: This mode targets ~4% monthly growth by leaning into leverage and concentration. Expect higher potential upside but also significantly larger drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses, especially with leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to remove volatility.
Maximize allocation to income ETF (QQQI) for distributions.
Reduce broad index (SPY) and growth index (QQQ) holdings.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over growth.
Focus is on capital preservation and reliable cash flow.
income.read: This mode targets ~1% monthly growth, prioritizing steady income and low drawdowns. Distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff, but the focus is on reliable cash flow.
